hints.text: Numbers above zero are positive and numbers below zero are negative. Decide which side of zero this temperature is on.
The size of the number is $5$. The word "below" tells you its sign, so put that sign in front of the $5$.
Below zero means negative, so the number is $-5$.

explanation: Zero is the reference point. Values above it are positive and values below it are negative.
The temperature is $5$ degrees away from zero, and the word "below" means it is on the negative side.
So "$5$ degrees below zero" is written as $-5$.
